statement: An output composed without `unit` is published but invisible to its period check: `documents.compose` carries the planning period in `unit`, and `verify-project.py::_published_for_period` reads the literal token `tranche-N` from the title or unit. Tranche 7's two PI rows were composed with a null unit and a title saying 'tranche 7', so every member's `pi_plan` and `pi_objectives` checks would have been red; every tranche 0-6 row carries `unit: tranche-N`. Compose the period into `unit` at creation, and verify the rendered `outputs.js` before the factory run.
